description: Schema stub for canonical trait objects in the Stellaris engine.

trait_object.name: string
trait_object.type: biological | machine | cyborg | overtuned | ascension | unique | pre_sapient
trait_object.cost: integer (trait point cost, can be negative)
trait_object.picks_used: integer (how many pick slots it consumes)
trait_object.modifiers: object (job output, growth, upkeep, habitability, ethics, etc.)
requires: array of tech ids, authorities, civics, archetypes, etc.
tags: array of strings for categorization, e.g. economic, military, growth
